description: This file defines API endpoints for user authentication including registration, login, email verification, password reset request, and password resetting, using FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, and various security and email utilities.

methods.name: register(payload: UserCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_session))
methods.description: Creates a new user, sends a verification email, and tracks the registration event.

methods.name: login(payload: UserLogin, db: Session = Depends(get_session))
methods.description: Authenticates user credentials, generates an access token, and tracks login event.

methods.name: verify_email(token: str = Form(...), db: Session = Depends(get_session))
methods.description: Verifies a user's email using a token, and updates their verified status.

methods.name: request_password_reset(email: EmailStr = Form(...), db: Session = Depends(get_session))
methods.description: Generates a password reset token and sends it to the user's email.

methods.name: reset_password(token: str = Form(...), new_password: str = Form(...), db: Session = Depends(get_session))
methods.description: Resets the user's password using a valid reset token.

ctags.name: request_password_reset
ctags.pattern: /^def request_password_reset(email: EmailStr = Form(...), db: Session = Depends(get_session)):$/

ctags.name: reset_password
ctags.pattern: /^def reset_password(token: str = Form(...), new_password: str = Form(...), db: Session = Depends(/
ctags.signature: (token: str = Form(...), new_password: str = Form(...), db: Session = Depends(get_session))

ctags.name: verify_email
ctags.pattern: /^def verify_email(token: str = Form(...), db: Session = Depends(get_session)):$/
